lane: مُحَصْرَمٌ Butter dissundered, or separated [into clots], by reason of intense cold; not coalescing; (K;) [as also ↓مُتَحَصْرِمٌ: see Q. 2.] === A scanty, or small, gift. (TA.) === Anything straitened, or scanted. (TA.) === See also حِصْرِمٌ, in two places. ___ شَاعِرٌ مُحَصْرَمٌ i. q. مُخَضْرَمٌ, (K,) which is the more common term; meaning A poet that lived in the time of paganism and in that of El-Islám. (TA.)

entries.text: (مُحَصْرَمٌ) : قَلِيلُ الْخَيْرِ. وَالْأَصْلُ أَنَّ الْمِيمَ زَائِدَةٌ، وَإِنَّمَا هُوَ مِنَ الْحَصُورِ وَالْحَصِرِ.||وَمِنْ هَذَا الْبَابِ
